Subject: Billing contact and invoice delivery — Atlas Health onboarding

Hi Evelyn,

We're kicking off procurement for the Redwood integration and need to confirm billing details before we can approve the first invoice. A few quick questions:

- Who should be the invoice originator / billing contact (name + email)?
- Do you support portal-only delivery? If so we'd prefer to enroll, but during the first billing cycle we need emailed PDF copies to finance@atlashealth.com as a backup.
- Our AP team requires PO number on the invoice and a VAT ID for reconciliation — I can provide both once you confirm the billing entity on your side.

Can you confirm what you need from us to enable portal enrollment (or alternatively an emailed PDF flow)? We're hoping to finalize this by EOD Friday so finance can schedule the payment run.

Thanks,

Alice Chen

Atlas Health
alice.chen@atlashealth.com
+1 415-555-0193

Subject: Re: Billing contact and invoice delivery — Atlas Health onboarding

Hi Alice —

Thanks, and welcome aboard. Quick answers and a proposed handoff plan:

1) Invoice originator / billing contact: Please use "Redwood Inference, Attn: Finance Billing" with bill-to contact as the email you want copied. On our side the operational owner will be me (evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com) for the first 30 days.

2) Delivery options: We support (a) Portal (preferred) with API/SFTP ingestion, (b) SFTP push of PDF/UBL, or (c) emailed PDF copies. To reduce friction, I recommend a staged migration: we enroll Atlas Health in our portal and continue to send emailed PDFs to finance@atlashealth.com for the first two invoices, then switch to portal-only.

3) PO & VAT: Please send the PO number and the VAT/Tax ID for the billing entity. We'll include the PO on the invoice reference field.

I've attached a short Portal Enrollment Guide (Portal-enroll-instructions.pdf) that lists required fields and expected lead times. Connor (cc'd) can follow up with technical onboarding details if you want SFTP/UBL integration.

If that plan works, reply with the PO and VAT ID and tell us which email should receive the transient PDF copies. We'll open the billing contact record and route the first invoice for manual confirmation.

Cheers,

Evelyn Hart
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: Portal-enroll-instructions.pdf (application/pdf, 220KB)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Billing contact and invoice delivery — Atlas Health onboarding

Hi Alice —

A few tech details to help your AP team choose:

- Portal API: we offer a REST endpoint for invoice retrieval and a web UI for register/enroll. We'll create a portal account and send an invite to the technical contact you provide.
- SFTP: we can push UBL or PDF to a customer SFTP. If you'd like us to push UBL, please share host details and SFTP user/key or an upload bucket. UBL schema version 2.1 is supported.
- Email: emailed PDF copies will be sent from invoices@redwoodinference.com and will include PO in the Reference field.

I've attached a sample UBL invoice (invoice-sample-ubl.xml) and an SFTP checklist. Two practical notes:

1) If you choose SFTP/UBL, confirm a key rotation window — our tokens expire after 30 days by default.
2) For portal enrollment, provide a technical contact (name + email) so we can issue the invite and API token.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through options.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Billing Integrations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: invoice-sample-ubl.xml (text/xml, 8KB)
